verses.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.modern: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

verses.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.modern: My brethren, count it all joy when You fall into divers temptations,

verses.kjv: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.modern: knowing this, that the trying of Your faith works patience.

verses.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.modern: But let patience have her perfect work, that You may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

verses.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.modern: If any of You lack wisdom, let Him ask of God, Who gives to all men liberally, and upbraids not; and it shall be given Him.

verses.kjv: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.modern: But let Him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For He who wavers is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

verses.kjv: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.modern: For let not that man think that he shall receive anything from the Lord.

verses.kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
verses.modern: A doubleminded man is unstable in all His ways.

verses.kjv: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
verses.modern: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that He is exalted,

verses.kjv: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.modern: but the rich, in that He is made low; because as the flower of the grass He shall pass away.

verses.kjv: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.modern: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withers the grass, and the flower thereof falls, and the grace of the fashion of it perishes; so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.modern: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.

verses.kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.modern: Let no man say when he is tempted, "I am tempted of God"; for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither does He tempt any man;

verses.kjv: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.modern: but every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

verses.kjv: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.modern: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin; and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.

verses.kjv: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.modern: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

verses.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.modern: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

verses.kjv: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.modern: Of His own will He begat us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of His creatures.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.modern: Therefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath;

verses.kjv: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.modern: for the wrath of man works not the righteousness of God.

verses.kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.modern: Therefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save Your souls.

verses.kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.modern: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving Your own selves.

verses.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.modern: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, He is like a man beholding his natural face in a glass;

verses.kjv: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.modern: for He beholds Himself, and goes His way, and straightway forgets what manner of man He was.

verses.kjv: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.modern: But whoever looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

verses.kjv: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
verses.modern: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridles not his tongue, but deceives his own heart, this man's religion is vain.

verses.kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.modern: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep Himself unspotted from the world.

chapters.summary: James instructs believers to count it all joy when they face various trials, for the trying of faith works patience. He teaches that every good and perfect gift comes from the Father of lights, that a man is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust, and that believers must be doers of the word and not hearers only.

verses.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.modern: My brethren, do not hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

verses.kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
verses.modern: For if there come to Your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there comes in also a poor man in vile raiment,

verses.kjv: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
verses.modern: and You have respect to Him who wears the gay clothing, and say to Him, "Sit here in a good place"; and say to the poor, "Stand there," or, "Sit here under my footstool,"

verses.kjv: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.modern: are You not then partial in yourselves, and become judges of evil thoughts?

verses.kjv: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
verses.modern: Listen, my beloved brethren, has not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which He has promised to those who love Him?

verses.kjv: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.modern: But You have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress You, and draw You before the judgment seats?

verses.kjv: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
verses.modern: Do they not blaspheme that worthy name by which You are called?

verses.kjv: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
verses.modern: If You fulfill the royal law according to the scripture, "You shall love Your neighbor as Yourself," you do well;

verses.kjv: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.modern: but if You have respect to persons, You commit sin, and are convicted of the law as transgressors.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
verses.modern: For whoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, He is guilty of all.

verses.kjv: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.modern: For He who said, "Do not commit adultery," said also, "Do not kill." Now if You commit no adultery, yet if You kill, You have become a transgressor of the law.

verses.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.modern: So speak, and so do, as those who shall be judged by the law of liberty.

verses.kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
verses.modern: For He shall have judgment without mercy who has shown no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.

verses.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.modern: What does it profit, my brethren, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? Can faith save Him?

verses.kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.modern: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

verses.kjv: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
verses.modern: and one of You say to them, "Depart in peace, be warmed and filled," notwithstanding You give them not those things which are needful to the body, what does it profit?

verses.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.modern: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.

verses.kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
verses.modern: Yes, a man may say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me Your faith without Your works, and I will show You my faith by my works.

verses.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.modern: You believe that there is one God; You do well. The devils also believe, and tremble.

verses.kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.modern: But will You know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

verses.kjv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.modern: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son on the altar?

verses.kjv: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
verses.modern: Do you see how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

verses.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
verses.modern: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, "Abraham believed God, and it was imputed to Him for righteousness," and He was called the Friend of God.

verses.kjv: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.modern: You see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

verses.kjv: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
verses.modern: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

verses.kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.modern: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

chapters.summary: James rebukes favoritism toward the rich in the assembly and teaches that if a man shows respect of persons he commits sin. He argues that faith without works is dead, citing Abraham who was justified by works when he offered Isaac, and Rahab who was justified by works when she received the messengers — for as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

verses.kjv: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
verses.modern: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

verses.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.modern: For in many things we all offend. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

verses.kjv: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.modern: We put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

verses.kjv: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.modern: See also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, wherever the governor wills.

verses.kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
verses.modern: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasts great things. See how great a matter a little fire kindles!

verses.kjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
verses.modern: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity; so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

verses.kjv: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
verses.modern: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind,

verses.kjv: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.modern: but the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

verses.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
verses.modern: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, who are made after the similitude of God.

verses.kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.modern: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

verses.kjv: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
verses.modern: Does a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

verses.kjv: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.modern: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? Either a vine, figs? So can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

verses.kjv: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.modern: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among You? Let Him show out of a good conversation His works with meekness of wisdom.

verses.kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.modern: But if You have bitter envying and strife in Your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

verses.kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.modern: This wisdom descends not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

verses.kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
verses.modern: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

verses.kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.modern: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

verses.kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.modern: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of those who make peace.

chapters.summary: James warns about the power of the tongue, declaring that it is a little member that boasts great things, a fire, a world of iniquity that no man can tame. He contrasts the wisdom from above — which is pure, peaceable, gentle, and full of mercy — with the wisdom that is earthly, sensual, and devilish, which produces envy and strife.

verses.kjv: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
verses.modern: From where come wars and fightings among you? Come they not from this — even from your lusts that war in your members?

verses.kjv: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.modern: You lust, and have not; you kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain; you fight and war, yet you have not, because you ask not.

verses.kjv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
verses.modern: You ask, and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may consume it on your lusts.

verses.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
verses.modern: You adulterers and adulteresses, do you not know that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

verses.kjv: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
verses.modern: Do you think that the scripture says in vain, "The spirit that dwells in us lusts to envy"?

verses.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
verses.modern: But He gives more grace. Therefore He says, "God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble."

verses.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.modern: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.kjv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verses.modern: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you doubleminded.

verses.kjv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.modern: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep; let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

verses.kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.modern: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and He shall lift you up.

verses.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.modern: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He who speaks evil of his brother, and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law, and judges the law; but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

verses.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
verses.modern: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy; who are you that judges another?

verses.kjv: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.modern: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain";

verses.kjv: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.modern: whereas you do not know what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

verses.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.modern: For you ought to say, "If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that."

verses.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.modern: But now you rejoice in your boastings; all such rejoicing is evil.

verses.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
verses.modern: Therefore to him that knows to do good, and does it not, to him it is sin.

chapters.summary: James identifies the source of quarrels and conflicts as the lusts that war within, and declares that friendship with the world is enmity with God. He calls on the proud to humble themselves before the Lord, warns against speaking evil of one another, and rebukes those who boast about tomorrow, saying their life is but a vapour that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

verses.kjv: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
verses.modern: Come now, you rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come on you.

verses.kjv: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.modern: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.

verses.kjv: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.modern: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. You have heaped treasure together for the last days.

verses.kjv: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
verses.modern: The hire of the laborers who have reaped down your fields, which is by you kept back by fraud, cries; and the cries of those who have reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

verses.kjv: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.modern: You have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; you have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

verses.kjv: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
verses.modern: You have condemned and killed the just; and he does not resist you.

verses.kjv: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.modern: Be patient therefore, brethren, to the coming of the Lord. The husbandman waits for the precious fruit of the earth, and has long patience for it, until He receive the early and latter rain.

verses.kjv: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.modern: Be also patient; establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord draws near.

verses.kjv: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
verses.modern: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest you be condemned; the judge stands before the door.

verses.kjv: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.modern: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

verses.kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.modern: We count them happy who endure. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord, that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

verses.kjv: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.modern: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath; but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay, lest you fall into condemnation.

verses.kjv: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.modern: Is any among you afflicted? Let him pray. Is any merry? Let him sing psalms.

verses.kjv: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.modern: Is any sick among you? Let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise Him up; and if He have committed sins, they shall be forgiven Him.

verses.kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.modern: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that you may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.

verses.kjv: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.modern: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain; and it did not rain on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

verses.kjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.modern: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

verses.kjv: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.modern: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him,

verses.kjv: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.modern: let him know that he who converts the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

chapters.summary: James warns the rich that their riches are corrupted and their gold and silver cankered, and that the hire of the labourers they kept back by fraud cries out to the Lord. He urges patience until the coming of the Lord, calls for prayer in affliction and praise in gladness, and declares that the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and that the effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.
